maddeler.e:
أغلولب (form XII)
# أَغْلَوْلِبُ (ʔaḡlawlibu) /ʔaɣ.law.li.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِغْلَوْلَبَ (iḡlawlaba)
# أَغْلَوْلِبَ (ʔaḡlawliba) /ʔaɣ.law.li.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِغْلَوْلَبَ (iḡlawlaba)
# أَغْلَوْلِبْ (ʔaḡlawlib) /ʔaɣ.law.lib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِغْلَوْلَبَ (iḡlawlaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
